method: NAIVE. Written straight from the deposited text using only the writing-l4-rules skill. No pipeline, no coverage table, no probe record, no independent test pass, no human gate. One pass, no review.
edition_encoded: Police Force Act 2004 (Singapore), 2020 Revised Edition, informal consolidation, as deposited at ../../registers/source-bundle/PFA2004.txt (amendments to Act 16 of 2024 and Act 43 of 2024). The arrangement of sections and the body diverge in numbering from Part 12; the encoding follows the body.
license: Apache-2.0 for the L4; the quoted statutory text is reproduced under the standing grant in SSO's Terms of Use cl.13 - see ../../SOURCE-LICENSE.md

checks.command: l4 run pfa-cases-powers.l4 ; l4 run pfa-cases-property-offences.l4
checks.note: l4 run exits 0 even when an assertion fails, so the diagnostics are what was read.

scope: SCOPED to what reaches members of the public. s 24(2) (no retrial after acquittal), s 25 (warrants), s 26 (road barriers), ss 26A to 26D (attempted-suicide powers and freezing property), s 26E (forced entry in medical emergencies), s 27 (private employment of police), s 64 (Commercial Affairs Officers), s 65B(2) and (3)(a)(vi) (forensic specialists), s 86A with the definition of security activity, ss 108 to 110 (lost property, small intestate estates, perishables), s 111, s 112A, s 115 and s 120A. Not encoded: the constitution, engagement and discipline of the Force, committees of inquiry, overseas service, air marshals, the Special Constabulary, the Auxiliary Police Forces regime beyond s 86A, the Police Fund, and the regulations and General Orders.
